notes.title: Update 1.3 - Major Overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.3[/h1]

[h2]Graphics:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Full Hardware Ray Tracing now implemented
[*] Updated landscape on all applicable levels
[*] More detailed models incorporated to match updated landscapes
[*] Updated lighting performance
[*] Foliage system revamped for certain levels.
[/list]

[h2]UI:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Player UI changed to match new aesthetics
[*] Tweak to XP progression bar
[/list]

[h2]Other:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Intro revamped
[*] Main Menu intros re-added
[*] Player models tweaked for better destruction performance
[/list]

notes.title: Damaging New Looks - Update 1.2.6
notes.content:
[h1]Update V 1.2.6[/h1]

[h2]2 New Head Models for Customization (MK1 and MK3)[/h2]
[list]
[*] These new head models are unlocked right away.
[*] Future head models will be unlocked through player achievements.
[*] Color unlocks are universal to any head model selected.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130112/3e95754951208efe4408f7e3ea832dbce34b4753.png[/img]

[h2]Updated Damage System [/h2]
[list]
[*] Three Alpha One Nine's chassis already displays the player's current health via it's indicator lights, but now the entire chassis will reflect the damage taken as well. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130112/1cfbac1151bea95a13e728211675a7c10c336f16.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130112/4024b7838322bb509d76ced016f92e665bfdce36.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130112/1ccaf6287b2d303f35db19b1767a1a4673d4b810.png[/img]

[h2]General Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some performance updates for tasks.
[*] Animation updates for the "Sprint" function.
[*] Backend work for upcoming game mode.
[/list]

[h2]Upcoming Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adventure Game Mode named "Contracts" which will be added episodically.
[*] Co-op Game Mode
[*] New Tasks
[*] More Customization
[/list]

tags.feature: 2 New Head Models for Customization (MK1 and MK3)
Updated Damage System
Animation updates for the "Sprint" function.
Backend work for upcoming game mode.

notes.title: Update: 1.2.5 - Pre-Release
notes.content:
[h1]Update V.1.2.5[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Re-designed the Rating System to a more streamlined Experience System
[*] Updated UI game wide for ease of use and access to information (including experience progress bar)
[*] Screen effects tweaked (Player Hit and Player Land)
[*] Collision fixes on most levels to stop unintended physics fluctuations
[*] New message indicator for new messages within the messaging system
[*] Fixed "Fastest Time" not displaying correctly if Time Achieved was more than the "Acceptable Time" threshold.
[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] General tweaks to all levels for increased frame rate
[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*] Customizable graphics options added for user
[*] Level intros updated for all levels
[/list]

Updated UI game wide for ease of use and access to information (including experience progress bar)
